title: How do I design a social media graphic?
problem_statement: You need an eye-catching image for a social media post, event or announcement and aren't a designer.
expected_outcome: A correctly sized graphic that is readable on a phone screen.

steps.title: Pick the right size
steps.instructions: Choose the design type for the platform you're posting to so the size and shape are correct.
steps.expected_result: A blank canvas at the right size.

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.instructions: Choose a template close to your message and replace text and images with your own.

steps.title: Make it readable
steps.instructions: Keep text short, use high contrast between text and background, and check it at phone size.
steps.expected_result: Text that is readable on a small screen.

steps.title: Export and post
steps.instructions: Download as PNG or JPG and add alt text describing the image when you post.
steps.expected_result: A posted graphic with alt text.

quality_checks: Text is readable at phone size.
The image isn't cropped by the platform.
Alt text is added when posting.
